card.name: Units and month names after numbers
card.fires_on: The word right after a number that names a unit of measure (tablespoons, mph) or a month in a day-first date (31 March, 6 June).

modes.label: Kitchen and speed units
modes.description: A unit such as tablespoons or mph directly after a number.

modes.label: Month in day-first date
modes.description: A month name following a day number in a British-style date.

card.plain: It marks the word that follows a number when that word is a measuring unit or a month in a date.
